description: Records one income or expense in an account. Confirmed by default (it already happened, date today or earlier); with forecast=true it is a planned future transaction (today or later). The amount is positive; the sign comes from `type`. Account and category ids are the ones returned by get_accounts_and_categories. Transfers between accounts are not supported. It can be undone from the app (Ctrl+Z).

amount.description: Positive amount in the account currency, up to 2 decimals.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

forecast.description: true = planned, not yet happened (default false).

idempotency_key.description: Optional: the same key within 24 h returns the first transaction instead of creating a duplicate.

scope.description: freelance = self-employed activity (needs the module). Default personal.

name: add_transaction
title: Add a transaction
